text:
Done. Summary of the change:

**`src/logger.h`** — added `inline auto LOG_WARNING() -> std::ostream &` next to `LOG_VERBOSE`. It prints `warning: ` to `std::cerr` and returns `std::cerr`, unconditionally (not gated on `--verbose`).

**Warning sites converted:**
- `src/command_lint.cc` — unknown-rule warning now `LOG_WARNING() << "Cannot exclude unknown rule: " ...`
- `src/command_validate.cc` — both the pre-compiled-template failure and the empty-JSONL warning
- `src/resolver.h` — all three lines of the multi-line warning
- `src/command_bundle.cc` — all six lines of the `--without-id` warning, plus a direct `#include "logger.h"` in the include block

**Tests updated** (kept registered as before): `test/validate/pass_jsonl_empty.sh` now expects the now-unconditional empty-JSONL warning; `test/bundle/pass_without_id.sh` and `test/bundle/pass_without_id_verbose.sh` expect the `warning: ` prefix on every continuation line.

**Evidence:** `make configure compile` succeeds (exit 0, clang-format and shellcheck targets clean). The targeted command returned 7/7 passed, and the full `ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` suite passed 301/301.
